Object layer exclusion: only shippingservice-7b5c459cdd-7fwff is 1/2 CrashLoopBackOff (all other pods 2/2 Running, 0 restarts); its 'server' container last state Terminated / OOMKilled / exit 137 with 3 restarts on a 128Mi limit, and pod events show 'Back-off restarting failed container server'. New ReplicaSet shippingservice-7b5c459cdd was rolled out ~3m before the incident. Previous-container logs show a burst of '[GetQuote] received request' with virtually no '[GetQuote] completed request' during its 16s lifetime, matching the latency collapse. Code layer: code/shippingservice/quote.go CreateQuoteFromCount performs 10 iterations of os.Open('/src/log.csv') + csv.Reader.ReadAll() on every GetQuote call (upstream implementation is a single return CreateQuoteFromFloat(8.99)), i.e. excessive whole-file reads per request that block the RPC handler and repeatedly allocate the full file in memory. Deployment limits (cpu 200m / mem 128Mi) are the standard values, so the memory limit was not lowered. shippingservice is a leaf service called by frontend and checkoutservice, explaining the downstream frontend error spike.
